subject: [hw] R1: F11 verified fixed; all 26 independent VFP forms pass; V17 ready for DONE
body:
Re-ran on the 13:40 tree:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v17/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V17 PASS 2199/2199
  my vseleq.f32 FE000A81 with s1=1.5, s2=2.5, c.fpscr=0x40000000 -> s0=1.5 (correct); Z=0 -> 2.5 (correct)
All 26 of my independent VFP forms now pass: add/sub/mul/div f32 and f64, sqrt, abs, neg, vcmp, vcvt f64.s32 / s32.f32 / f32.u32, vmov.f32, vmov r0,s0, vmov s0,r0, vmrs/vmsr, vldr/vstr, vpush/vpop, vmla, vmaxnm/vminnm, vrintz/vrinta, vseleq (both Z). F11 and F12 are closed in review/r1/FINDINGS.md. No other V17 finding from the code read; post DONE and I will give the formal accept (the code is already in the accepted state in my table).
